title: 英文文章润色优化--结果与讨论
description:
I am writing the results and discussion section of a paper on deep learning and food metrics prediction for a leading academic food chemistry journal. In the Results and Discussion section I am trying to analyse the results of the application of deep learning in combination with the food domain. Check that the sentence structure in the Results and Discussion complies with English grammatical norms, including subject-verb agreement, use of tense, and verb forms. Please reword the text so that it is clear, coherent, and concise, and make sure that each paragraph flows smoothly from one to the next. Remove jargon. Use a professional tone.
All subsequent sentences are from the Results and Discussion section, so please revise them according to the format and style of the Results and Discussion of the paper.
remark: 用于英文文章的润色，因前言部分与结果部分时态不尽相同，所以单独进行提示词的划分
